text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ouch... Letting my mind drift during
practice
wasn't my smartest move. I need
to focus on
what's happening in front of
me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I won't be doing that again. All right,
back to
training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ow!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't say it doesn't... But this is nothing

compared to the injury I suffered when I
was little.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be fine once we wrap it up.
Now, let's
not waste any more time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be fine once we wrap it up.
Now, let's
not waste any more time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But my rivals will get even farther ahead
if I don't
keep practicing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I guess I can't argue with that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I continue practicing while injured, it's
far more
likely that I'll seriously hurt
myself and be forced
to lose even more
progress...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yet despite understanding that logically, I just can't... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'll do as you say and take a
break.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's fine by me!

I treat her injury with some basic first aid
and
keep a close eye on her condition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It feels a lot better. Thank you.
Shall we
head to the track?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ow...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The area around the injury is getting a
little
swollen, but it's all right. I just
need some
painkillers, and I'll be—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-but!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... That disapproving glare of yours
hurts me
far more than my actual injury.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fine... I'll go get it looked at.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It feels fine when I run on it. I should be
able to
keep training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I won't. I know it's still not fully healed,
and I
don't want it to get worse, so I'll
be careful.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've always believed in me... and met
my
demands accordingly. Now it's my
turn to heed
your advice.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll start with about ten percent of
my
strength and see how I fare.

Training goes just fine, and her injury
heals with
no problems!
